scope: Read-only inventory of the accepted corrected linear deBelly native API and stepping dependencies; not an integration/fidelity acceptance.
dispatch: native.run -> native.ds=models.debelly.simulate_debelly(initial_checkpoint=state), step0.5. Generic polarity1d.debelly lacks this full restart API.
corrected_model_parameters: Existing corrected runner wraps model_for with center_boundary_motion=False; models.debelly._parameters alone retains centred defaults. Assay mode remains reflection_symmetric_extension, no passive boundary or substrate clutch.
restart_dependencies: Rac/Rho, bound/unboundMCA and displacement/velocity/tension are copied fieldwise.

Raw and effective left/right boundary displacements are restored independently from the complete native checkpoint; four scalar fields are read from their first stored value, so their repeated-array representation must be preserved and checked.

Oldvelocity enters membrane force balance; oldtension enters protrusion; oldbound/unboundMCA enter staggered exchange; raw/effective boundary histories enter displacement and membrane boundary velocities.
The native totalMCA reference is computed after checkpoint restoration; it is a nominal-grid bound-plus-unbound budget, not a physical moving-domain Rac amount.
update_order: Evaluate external input at the beginning of each native substep.
Use oldRac/tension to update raw endpoint commands; derive independent effective endpoint displacement/cortical boundary velocities.
Solve membrane displacement, compute membrane velocity and tension.
Update boundMCA using oldunbound, then unbound using newbound; apply native uniform replacement closure.
Solve cortical velocity from updatedMCA and the oldRho active-stress gradient.
UpdateRac using newMCA/tension/external and oldRho, then updateRho using newRac.
Advance clock and record at the requested outputtarget.
sampling_pitfall: Requested output times are actual staggered integration stops, not dense-output interpolation. Keep every output/event/withdrawal on the0.5 lattice for the accepted native0.5 update. Sub0.5 stops change dynamics; default no-clutch boundary relaxation0.98 is applied perstep and is not renormalized bydt.
withdrawal: Accepted trials integrate an alwaysON constant patch through the left limit, extract all11states, then call a separate native cue-free phase from localtime0. A time-gated cue that changes during the last update is not equivalent. Derived rac_activation may jump at withdrawal; the11dynamicfields must remain continuous.
coordinates: The input uses fixed nominal Grid1D.x and Grid1D.length, independent of displacement. The accepted adapter samples cell centres. Do not relabel it an instantaneous physical-distance actuator or remap its input to moving endpoints.
hidden_history: No additional external history state appears in the accepted autonomous no-clutch branch. Native homogeneous referenceRac/Rho is recomputed from unchanged parameters/step for thresholds; optional substrateclutch introduces extra state and is outside this campaign.
pilot_implications: Compare shared-prefix versus independently stopped native fullstates and first/last direct-native cue-free continuations. Preserve raw state/geometry, separate derived activation jumps, report actual finite outcome agreement and fixed-scale errors. V1unlaunched freeze is preserved; final implementation preflight targets the new v2 hash.
